cases.policy: Cycle helmets are worn on the pump track at all times, except during the toddler hour.
Photography is banned inside the print room, except for cases where the curator has signed a shoot pass.
Provided that the cash sheet does not show red, the tuck hatch may stay open.
Do not key up the community transmitter unless the duty log has been countersigned.
Apart from a declared emergency, the side door stays locked at all times.
The drag store is out of bounds while drill bookings are posted, unless the quartermaster or her deputy clears the visit.
Members' dinghies may be launched whenever the slip light is not showing red, except when the warden posts a closure notice.
Unless the meter reads zero, the amp rack must be powered down between sets.
Duty pilots who have filed a flight plan may enter the hangar mezzanine, except when the foam drill is running.
Once the pasteurisation cycle has finished, the cream vats may be opened, unless the thermostat reads amber.
Figures for the gate count and the locker tally come from the turnstile log alone, each on its own form.
No more than three storm lanterns per raft on the night crossing, save when the trip lead okays a fourth.
Provided the wind meter is not in the red zone, the balcony telescope may be used after dark.
Writing the tank figures into the board book is not optional whenever the hatch is open.
Before the auction opens, the paddle cards and the bidder sheets are counted, each on its own tray.
Stewards may park behind the members' pavilion, except on concert nights.
Nurses may top up the syrup dispenser; only the pharmacist may unlock the drug cupboard.
Trainees must log every pool session, and trainees may not enter the filter gallery.
The intern may fetch slides from the cold store; the intern must not touch the liquid-nitrogen dewar.
Only the senior falconer may hand-feed the display owls, and the falconers must wear gauntlets for every handling.
Docents may open the butterfly house in the morning; horticulturists may enter the potting vault at any time.
The night porter must patrol the sculpture gallery, and may not move the plinths.
Scribes may copy the index cards; the registrar alone may annotate the folios; nobody removes the vellum leaves.
When the barometer is falling, the winch launch is off limits to cadets; instructors may keep launching until dusk.
The service lift can carry four adults at a squeeze. Passengers must face the doors while it moves.
Nothing in the harbour by-laws prevents early baiting of the lobster pots.
Bleach must never be mixed with ammonia at the cleaning bench.
Every hire punt is bailed and wiped down before the boat shed is locked.
Members may moor their dinghies at the north pontoon.
Season holders are entitled to use the clay courts outside peak hours.
Adjusting the loom dwell is reserved to the master weaver.
Juniors may use the bouldering wall during staffed hours; the roof ladder is out of bounds to everyone.
So long as the kiln timer has not sounded, members may keep using the glaze room.
Freight may use the ferry slip only while the yard lamp shows green.
The clean-room hatch may stand open exactly while the external auditor is on site.
Unless the standpipe is lagged against frost, the yard tap must be drained each evening.
While the smoke test is running, the spray booth is out of bounds, except when the maintenance fitter carries a mask card.
Whenever the drag line snaps or the pit winch overheats, the pit floor is closed to everyone.
If the delivery van takes the late run, parcels are stacked in the steel cage; if it takes the early run, parcels wait on the shelf.
While the visiting assessor is on site, the rooftop terrace and the tunnel wing are both closed to unescorted staff.
Only when the river gauge is not showing amber may the orchard well be inspected.
Teaching-lab glassware never goes into the skip, save when the technician has logged it as scrap.
Once the dough has proved, the deck oven may be lit, provided the flue damper is open.
After hours, only bearers of the green fob may enter the relay room; the yellow fob opens nothing.
